scope: Interior chromaticity fallback and bounded physical-registration hole repair; original artwork and template acceptance gates unchanged.

native.timeLimit: Requested solver search allowance, not an end-to-end latency limit.
native.detectionSeconds: Crop detection wall time. Decoding and the source thumbnail are outside this timer.
native.runSeconds: Each runs[].seconds starts after crop detection and source-thumbnail creation. Includes preparation, solving, validation, export, independent replay and per-case artifact writes; excludes decoding and detection.
native.solveAndValidationSeconds: design() wall time, including final validation and generated export data. Excludes crop detection, preparation, independent replay and writing artifacts.
native.independentReplaySeconds: Separate exported-SVG renderer wall time; not part of application solving.
native.browser: Actual click-to-ready latency is measured separately by paint-browser-test.mjs.

clocks.browser: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.
clocks.qualification: Browser cases use the recorded 180-second setting and are not evidence of a ten-second browser latency bound. Crop detection is separate from native fit/validation.
